meta.prompt: Compare two phone plans side by side. Lite: $25 a month, 10 GB data, 500 minutes of calls, roaming not included, monthly contract, no extras. Max: $45 a month, unlimited data, unlimited calls, roaming in the EU and US, 24-month contract, streaming and 5G included. Mark the better plan on each row (cheaper price, more data, more calls, roaming, shorter contract, more extras). Under the table a recommendation with one sentence that says how many of the six rows the recommended plan wins and how much more it costs per month, and a Choose button under each plan; once I choose, the card says which plan I picked.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Phone plans" "Lite against Max" icon:"compare_arrows" status:"Compare"
  ComparisonTable names:["Lite","Max"] prices:["$25/mo","$45/mo"] pick:1 pickLabel:"Best value" cta:"Choose" rows:[["Data","10 GB","Unlimited",2],["Calls","500 min","Unlimited",2],["Roaming","Not included","EU and US",2],["Contract","Monthly","24 months",1],["Extras","None","Streaming and 5G",2],["Price","$25/mo","$45/mo",1]] -> pick=1
  if pick==0
    Receipt "Lite chosen" "You picked the Lite plan at $25 a month." tone:good icon:"check_rounded"
  if pick==2
    Receipt "Max chosen" "You picked the Max plan at $45 a month." tone:good icon:"check_rounded"
